mean_cn: adj.给人深刻印象的；令人钦佩的
mean_en: (of things or people) making you feel admiration, because they are very large, good, skilful, etc.
sentence: The acrobatic performance left an impressive impact on the audience.
sentence_trans: 杂技表演给观众留下了很深刻的印象。
